title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Lucky Spin is a scale-up building education apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Fennick.

Our stack: kotlin, swift, dart. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and review code with the team.

Modern devices for testing. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
